newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hang Seng Index Services says doubt on HK quotes.
newsitem.headline: Hang Seng Index Services says doubt on HK quotes.

text.p: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index (HSI) Services said it could not confirm Hong Kong's Hang Seng index opening quotes on Thursday.
"Upto now we still cannot confirm them. We are checking with the stock exchange," HSI Services spokesman Tony Chui told Reuters.
"The calculation of the index is based on the stock prices provided by the stock exchange."
The figures showed the Hang Seng index plunging about 515 points in the opening minutes of trade and then quickly rebounding about 400 points.
The Hang Seng closed 193 points lower on Wednesday at 13,149.60.
At 10.30 am (0230 GMT) on Thursday, Hong Kong's industry watchdog, the Securities and Futures Commission (SFC), said the Hang Seng index was now operating properly.
The blue chip indicator stood at 13,095.83, down 93.77 at the time.
Hong Kong's industry watchdog, the Securities and Futures Commission, said the exchange would put out a statement later.
